# TurtleLauncher Baseline Profile (starter / hand-authored)
#
# NOT generated by Macrobenchmark - this repo has no instrumented-test setup and this
# environment can't run one (no device/emulator). This is a conservative, hand-written
# starter listing classes that are certainly touched on every single cold start, so ART
# can AOT-compile them at install time instead of interpreting/JIT-warming them on first
# launch - the JIT warm-up cost this avoids is proportionally worst on exactly the
# low-end devices this is meant to help.
#
# Safe by construction: AGP's profile tooling (profgen) silently drops any rule it can't
# resolve to a real class/method instead of failing the build, so an imprecise or
# partially-stale entry here is a missed optimization, never a build break.
#
# For a real, comprehensive profile - reflecting actual measured startup/launch/UI-nav
# behavior instead of an educated guess - this should eventually be replaced/extended
# with one generated via the Jetpack Macrobenchmark library
# (https://developer.android.com/topic/performance/baselineprofiles/overview) run against
# a real device or emulator, which this environment doesn't have.

# App entry points
Lcom/endiq/turtlelauncher/ui/activity/SplashActivity;
Lnet/endiq/launcher/TurtleApplication;
Lnet/endiq/launcher/LauncherActivity;

# Startup sequencing (this session's addition)
Lcom/endiq/turtlelauncher/startup/TurtleStartupInitializer;

# Touched on every cold start regardless of which screen the user lands on
Lcom/endiq/turtlelauncher/setting/AllSettings;
Lcom/endiq/turtlelauncher/setting/AllSettings$Companion;
Lcom/endiq/turtlelauncher/feature/log/Logging;
Lcom/endiq/turtlelauncher/task/TaskExecutors;
Lcom/endiq/turtlelauncher/utils/path/PathManager;
Lcom/endiq/turtlelauncher/context/ContextExecutor;

# Home screen (first thing rendered after splash in the common case)
Lnet/endiq/launcher/fragments/MainMenuFragment;
Lcom/endiq/turtlelauncher/feature/turtle/AssetPrefetcher;
